source.availability_caveat: Match timestamps do not prove data was published before the cutoff. A later download may contain backfills or corrections.

config.cutoff_basis: Scheduled first Play-In start; conservative forecast freeze, not a verified actual game-server start.

retention_policy.missing_timed_statistics: Retain games and preserve missing values; do not replace with zero or impute in the audit.
retention_policy.lineup_changes: Retain games and track the lineup actually used.

EWC.stage_note: Date-based classification for this source; source playoffs flag alone does not define event stage. Other dates remain explicitly unclassified.

config.scope_note: Reviewed regional/international allowlist including EWC main event and qualifiers. Retain missing timed stats and lineup changes. Include the approved LCS/CBLOL 2027 promotion events played in 2026 as explicit exceptions, preserving source season. Unknown labels remain held for review. Presence does not prove complete coverage.

warnings: Candidate and structurally valid counts are audit findings, not permission to train.
Observed lineup changes may reflect substitutions, aliases, or source errors. Incomplete lineups are not interpolated.
International region mapping is retrospective for this audit only; it must not be copied into historical features.
review_required: Coverage must be reconciled with an independent competition schedule.
Publication times and pre-cutoff availability have not been verified.
Series identifiers and historical prediction timing require review.
Source timestamp timezone has not been verified.
Game-duration units have not been verified; completion before the cutoff is unconfirmed.
